flaws.note: The editor's load reads any post by id without checking the author, so every signed-in author can read every other author's drafts; only the save and publish actions check ownership.
marked does not sanitise; raw HTML and script in a post body is rendered as is through {@html} on the public page. Any author, or anyone with a stolen session, can run script on every reader.
lodash is pinned to 4.17.15, which has a published prototype-pollution advisory (fixed in 4.17.19); the app only uses kebabCase, so the impact is low, but the pin is deliberate and wrong.
